description: This PHP class 'AccessFlowStateMachineDao' provides data access methods for managing workflow state machine records, including retrieval, saving, updating, and deleting workflow states and transitions within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for workflow state machine operations, extending BaseDao.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Retrieves allowed actions for a given workflow, optional state, and role.

methods.name: getAllowedWorkflowItems
methods.description: Retrieves workflow items for a given workflow, optional state, and role.

methods.name: getNextState
methods.description: Fetches the next state in the workflow based on current state, role, and action.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Retrieves states where specific actions are allowed for a given workflow and role.

methods.name: saveWorkflowStateMachineRecordAsArray
methods.description: Persists an array of WorkflowStateMachine entities.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Deletes a specific workflow state machine record based on parameters.

methods.name: deleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Deletes workflow records associated with a specific user role and optional workflow.

methods.name: handleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Updates role names in workflow state machine records after a role rename.

methods.name: getAllAlowedRecruitmentApplicationStates
methods.description: Retrieves all allowed recruitment application states for a given workflow and role.

methods.name: getWorkFlowStateMachineRecords
methods.description: Retrieves workflow state machine records for a given workflow and optional role.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a specific action is allowed in a given workflow, state, and role.

methods.name: getWorkflowItem
methods.description: Retrieves a workflow state machine record by its ID.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Retrieves a workflow state machine record matching specific workflow, state, action, and role.
